question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Do a good turn
solution:
The correct answer is-** '​Do an act of kindness'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'****Do a good turn​****​'** is 'Do an act of kindness'.
 
• Let’s look at the meaning and example of the given phrasal verb:
 
 
• Do a good turn- "If you do someone a good turn, you do something that helps or benefits them".(यदि आप किसी को अच्छा मोड़ देते हैं, तो आप कुछ ऐसा करते हैं जो उनकी मदद या लाभ करता है।)
 
 
• *E.g. He did you a **good turn by** resigning. One good turn deserves another.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​*Thus from the explanation given above, we find that the 2nd option is the correct choice.
